Content: In order to model the motion of an extinct ape, scientists measure its hand and arm bones. From shoulder to wrist, the arm bones are `0.60` `text(m)` long and their mass is `4.0` `text(kg)`. From wrist to the tip of the fingers, the hand bones are `0.10` `text(m)` long and their mass is `1.0` `text(kg)`. In the model above, `text(each bone)` is assumed to have a uniform density.
